test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A salesman sells an item at a profit of 24%. If he had bought it at 12% less and sold it for ₹69 less, he would have gained 20%. Find the cost price of the item.
solution:
**Solution:**

Let the CP of the article be x.

If the Salesman sells the article of 24 % Profit, then SP of the article = x × (124 / 100)

If the Salesman had purchased the article 12 % less, the new CP of the article = x × (88 / 100)

According to Question,

⇒ [(124x/100) - 69] - (88x/100) = (88x/100) × (20/100)

⇒ 1.24x - 69 - .88x = 0.176x

⇒ .36x - 69 = 0.176

⇒ .36x - 0.176x = 69

⇒ 0.184x = 69

⇒ x = (69 × 1000)/184 = 375

**∴ The Cost price of the item is 375**
